hero.title: Run your campaign without losing track of a single detail.
hero.lead: Kanka is a community driven world building website. Are you making your own D&D homebrew campaign or using other TTRPG systems? We help you manage, organize, and keep track of your ideas, your creations, and your world.
hero.trailing: 425,000+ game masters and worldbuilders call Kanka their home.
hero.videoCaption: Watch a short 45 second overview of Kanka

pitch.title: Everything in one place. Find it in seconds, even mid-session
pitch.body: Notes scattered across docs, wikis, and napkins don't survive contact with a live session. In Kanka, everything lives in one place and everything connects. {'@'}mention a character in a session log and it links automatically, so one click takes you from a city to its ruler to the war they started. When a player asks the question you didn't prep for, the answer is one search away, on any device.

features.f1Title: The free tier isn't a trial
features.f1Lead: All core features, unlimited campaigns, unlimited entries. Most GMs never need to pay, and we'd rather you stay because you love it, not because a paywall trapped your world.
features.f2Title: Run it with your whole table
features.f2Lead: Invite your players and co-GMs, then control exactly what each person sees and edits. Your secrets stay secret until you're ready to reveal them.
features.f3Lead: Rename categories, restructure to fit your system, or go deep with custom CSS and community plugins. Kanka bends to how you run your game: 5e, a homebrew system, or no system at all.
features.f4Title: A place for every part of your world
features.f4Lead: Characters, locations, organizations, families, timelines, calendars, maps, 20+ categories, each built for a piece of your world, all linked together.

socialProof.title: You're in good company
socialProof.lead: 425,000+ game masters and worldbuilders trust Kanka for their worldbuilding needs. We've gathered a few of their testimonials to show what Kanka can do for you.

t1.quote: "I got fed up with Obsidian's lack of focus and World Anvil's clunkiness, so here I am, building my own world—and so far I'm really liking the app."

t2.quote: "Got annoyed with how LegendKeeper felt, and other tools seemed overly complicated for no good reason. Kanka has helped me organize my world and thoughts on a much deeper level."

t3.quote: "I've been playing and running games for over 30 years and don't have lots of free time to fight with another tool. Kanka is way more user friendly for both me and my players."

t4.quote: "Found Kanka after looking for a website that doesn't nickel-and-dime you for every little thing. Loving it so far! It's really helping me release my creativity in worldbuilding."

trust.title: Your world is safe, and it's yours
trust.f1Lead: Download your content anytime. No lock-in, ever.
trust.f2Lead: We use reputable German hosting services, and we back up our servers twice daily.
trust.f3Lead: Kanka's code is public on GitHub, nothing hidden in a black box.

team.title: Who we are
team.body: Kanka started in 2017 when Jay needed a better way to track our campaign so Jon could keep ignoring the main plotline. Nearly a decade later, it's still just the two of us, no venture capital, no corporate roadmap, 100% funded by subscribers who love the tool. When you email support or hop into Discord, you're talking directly to the people building Kanka. We're not going anywhere, and we're building the worldbuilding home we want to run our own games in.

featured.title: Featured campaigns
featured.lead: Our community builds amazing things that we love to showcase as Featured Campaigns. These are great examples of worldbuilding that we recommend you check out. They can also showcase what other users have done with Kanka, and give you some inspiration!

hero.title: Craft richer worlds with the tools your campaign actually needs
hero.lead: Kanka packs everything a game master or worldbuilder needs into one place: characters, locations, maps, calendars, timelines, and more. Free for the core stuff, with upgrades when you're ready.

general.title: General
general.freeBody: Tired of having to pay for basic features like unlimited campaigns, having limits on the number of elements in a campaign, or not being able to control who sees what? We are too, which is why all core features of Kanka are absolutely free. We also have some {bonuses} that are nice to have, though not essential.
general.collaborativeBody: Kanka is built for worlds with multiple players and authors. Invite your friends, assign them roles, and control exactly what they can see and do. For peace of mind, you can preview your campaign from any member's perspective at any time so that nothing stays visible that shouldn't be.
general.modularBody: We've focused our efforts on building about 20 different categories in Kanka that each focus on one aspect of playing a TTRPG or wordbuilding in general. In each campaign, you can create characters, locations, families, organisations, items, quests, journals, calendars, events, abilities and more. Don't need abilities? No problem, you can disable categories of your choice in each campaign, simplifying your setup to focus on what's important to you.
general.updatesBody: Kanka is shaped by a large, active community of worldbuilders and game masters. We take pride in shipping features our users actually want, with on average one major updates every few weeks. We share what's coming on our {discord} and collect feedback before we build, so the community always has a voice in where Kanka goes next.
general.dashboardsBody: The dashboard is your campaign's home base. Customize it with widgets from a broad selection of options, arranging everything the way your group needs it. Running a large west march campaign with multiple player groups? Premium campaigns can set up separate dashboards tailored to each role.
general.dashboardsCaption: Fully customizable dashboards for your worlds

rpgs.title: RPGs
rpgs.entriesBody: Kanka is built around a list of around 20 different entries. These are the pre-defined types of core objects in a campaign. They include characters, locations, families, items, quests, journals, calendars, timelines, and more. They all share some functionality but are unique in their own way and interact with other elements of your campaign.
rpgs.entriesCaption: Craft beautiful pages for your story's protagonists
rpgs.inventoryBody: Every entry can have its own inventory. This feature is used to manage a character's possessions, a shop's (location) sale inventory, a quest's reward for completion, a family's fortune, or any other scenarios you can think of. The inventory feature interacts with the items of your campaign, but is flexible and can be used without creating every item in your campaign.
rpgs.inventoryCaption: Full a character's inventory to the brim
rpgs.abilitiesBody: As with inventories, every entry can have abilities. Create abilities in your campaign, and attach them to your entries. These can be the powers of a character, the effects of a lair (location), a special ability granted from being part of a family, or a curse caused by eating a hag's cupcake. Abilities have charges to keep track of how often they were used, and can be combined with an entry's properties.
rpgs.abilitiesCaption: Add powers and special abilities to any entry
rpgs.propertiesBody: Probably the most confusing and complex feature of entries are their properties. These can be little bits of information like tracking a character's HP, a location's population, a religion (organisation)'s number of shrines, etc. Properties can reference other properties to calculate values, for example a character's HP, where HP = Level * Constitution.
rpgs.propertiesBody2: An entry's properties can also be styled to look like a TTRPG character sheet by using our {pluginLibrary}.
rpgs.propertiesCaption: Track HP, Level, Strengh and more
rpgs.journalsBody: Plan your session or write a session recap in the eyes of a character using our journals category. These can be attached to calendars to keep track of both a real world date and an in-game date where something happened.
rpgs.questsBody: Prepare and keep track of your game's quests, where they will take the players, who's involved, and what organisations are secretly pulling the strings. Once a quest is complete, flag it as such and move on to the next one.
rpgs.questsCaption: Track starting conditions, rewards, and more

worldbuilding.title: Worldbuilding
worldbuilding.relationsBody: Need to keep track that Svynna is the rival of Mykel, or that Washington is the birthplace of Kyle? Use our relations tool to set up and keep track of all the connections between the entries of your world. Need a relation to be kept secret from your players? Easy, just set the relation to private!
worldbuilding.relationsBody2: {premiumCampaigns} have access to a visual explorer for the relations of an entry.
worldbuilding.relationsCaption1: Track connections and relations between entries
worldbuilding.relationsCaption2: Explore how elements of your world are connected
worldbuilding.timelinesBody: Timelines allow you to visually see and plan out a country's history, a family's rise to power, a character's story arc, and other options. Timelines are split in eras, and each era contains elements of text that can be attached to other entries of your campaign.
worldbuilding.timelinesCaption: Interactive timelines to explore how history unfolds
worldbuilding.calendarsBody: Create one or several calendars of your world, fully controlling the number of days in a year, the months, length of weeks, seasons, moons and their phases, and more. Attach events to your calendars linked to other entries, such as automatically calculating a character's age based on the calendar.
worldbuilding.mapsBody: Upload your beautiful maps to your Kanka campaign, and add layers and pins to them. Control who can see which pin, to avoid revealing the secret location of an infamous city to your players.
worldbuilding.editorBody: You won't need to learn programming to craft beautiful texts. We've build our own writing experience, so that you can create rich text for all your writing. Best of all, we've added support for mentions to other entries by using the {at} symbol.
worldbuilding.editorCaption: Use easy {'@'} mentions to link to other entries

premium.title: Premium
premium.premiumCampaignsBody: Some features are only available to premium campaigns. When a user subscribes to Kanka, they can upgrade a set number of campaigns. These premium campaigns can be moved around from one campaign to another, such as when a campaign ends. As long as a user stays a subscriber, their premium campaigns will stay that way.
premium.marketplaceBody: Premium campaigns can install plugins from the {pluginLibrary}. These are themes, character sheets or content packs, which are created by the community for the community. New content is added frequently.
premium.themingBody: Premium campaigns can force the theme users see when viewing it, but also write their own CSS to fully customise the campaign's look and feel. If CSS is an alien language to you, we also have an easy theme builder.
premium.familyTreesBody: Families in premium campaign have access to beautiful family trees.
premium.webhooksBody: Premium campaigns can define workflows that send updates to Discord and other tools through webhooks when changes to entries are made.

about.title: A tiny team making worldbuilding fun and reliable
about.lead: Kanka was born out of a frustration with worldbuilding and session notes scattered around in various tools, and the difficulty of easily sharing that content with players. Today, Kanka is a small group of friends spread around the world focused on building the best tools for those original needs.
about.communityBody: Community has and always will be big part of Kanka's DNA. We frequently survey our users for changes to features, designs, and incorporate feedback into every big decision. Our community is what drives us to endlessly improve Kanka.
about.historyBody: Kanka was first created in October 2017 by Jay as a hobby project over a weekend, and work seriously began in 2020 when Jon joined.
about.translationsBody: Kanka is translated to several languages thanks to these amazing contributors.

comparison.title: Kanka vs World Anvil: Choosing Your Worldbuilding Platform
comparison.lead: Both Kanka and World Anvil are built for creators crafting deep worlds, but they take very different approaches. World Anvil shines for novelists who want dedicated manuscript and publishing tools, while Kanka is built for game masters and worldbuilders who want a fast, structured, private-by-default world with unlimited entries, all without paying for core basics.
comparison.tableTitle: At a glance: Kanka vs World Anvil

table.freeTierKanka: Unlimited campaigns & entries, private by default
table.freeTierComp: Limited articles & worlds, public-only on free tier
table.learningCurveKanka: Clean, consistent interface ready in minutes
table.permissionsComp: Private worlds & advanced permissions require paid tiers
table.toolsKanka: 20+ categories, custom categories, calendars, timelines, maps, quests
table.ownershipKanka: Full campaign export anytime; source-available on GitHub
table.ownershipComp: Closed-source; export options vary by tier
table.priceComp: Paid tiers required for private worlds

comparison.ownershipBody1: Your world is yours. Kanka lets you export your entire campaign whenever you want, with no paywall locking your lore inside. Kanka is also source-available on GitHub, meaning you can inspect how it works rather than trusting a closed black box. Oh, and we've been independent and subscriber-funded since 2017.
comparison.ownershipBody2: World Anvil is closed-source, with private worlds and full export capabilities tied to paid subscription tiers.
comparison.testimonialQuote: "Everything is in logical places and seems to be working in logical ways. The learning curve is much more friendly."
comparison.interfaceBody1: Kanka focuses on an intuitive, clean interface that feels familiar to modern web users. The platform emphasizes getting started quickly with minimal setup time. All core features are accessible through a consistent, easy-to-navigate menu structure.
comparison.interfaceBody2: World Anvil offers a more elaborate interface with extensive customization options. While powerful, new users may need more time to learn the system and set up their world effectively.
comparison.preview1Alt: Kanka campaign dashboard showing characters and a calendar integrated in one view
comparison.preview1Caption: Kanka campaign dashboard showing characters and a calendar integrated in one view
comparison.contentBody1: Kanka uses a flexible entry-based system where everything (characters, locations, organizations, etc.) is treated equally. This allows for natural interconnections between all elements of your world. The relationship system lets you create complex webs of connections while maintaining clarity.
comparison.contentBody2: World Anvil takes a more article-centric approach, with a focus on detailed wiki-style entries. This approach particularly benefits writers, offering robust tools for organizing lore, story arcs, and narrative elements. While connections between elements exist, they're structured more like traditional wiki links.
comparison.preview2Caption: Characters come alive when they are connected to the rest of your world
comparison.rpgTitle: RPG Campaign Management and Writing Tools
comparison.rpgBody1: Kanka was built from the ground up with tabletop RPG campaigns in mind. The quest system, calendar integration, and character management tools are deeply integrated with each other, making it natural to run ongoing campaigns alongside worldbuilding. The focus is on practical tools for game masters and players.
comparison.rpgBody2: World Anvil excels at supporting writers with specialized features like manuscript organization, plot development tools, and detailed character arcs. Their campaign tools are more focused on presenting information to players, with strong features for revealing selective content and managing reading permissions.
comparison.preview3Alt: Kanka quest view to track moving parts
comparison.preview3Caption: Quests with lots of moving parts can become difficult to keep track of in traditional software.
comparison.customizationBody1: Kanka emphasizes extensibility through its community plugin system. Users can enhance their worlds with community-created plugins that add new features and functionality, while maintaining the platform's core ease of use. The platform also supports custom CSS for those who want to personalize their world's appearance.
comparison.customizationBody2: World Anvil also offers extensive visual customization through CSS and templates, though this may require more technical knowledge to fully utilize.
comparison.collaborationBody1: Kanka provides a straightforward permission system that works across all content types. Teams can easily work together with granular access controls that are consistent throughout the platform. Kanka also comes with fully collaborative maps and whiteboards with live updates going out to all collaborators.
comparison.collaborationBody2: World Anvil offers collaboration tools with a focus on community features and content sharing between different worldbuilders.
comparison.kankaStrength1: Unified entry system that treats all content types equally
comparison.kankaStrength2: Intuitive relationship mapping between any elements
comparison.kankaStrength4: Strong integration between worldbuilding and campaign management
comparison.kankaStrength5: Quick setup and minimal learning curve
comparison.waStrength2: Strong focus on traditional wiki-style organization
comparison.waStrength3: Robust template system for consistent articles
comparison.conclusionBody: Choose Kanka if you want a modern, intuitive platform that seamlessly blends worldbuilding with RPG campaign management, and value quick setup with consistent organization tools.
comparison.preview4Alt: Kanka dashboard with intro, calendar, recaps
comparison.preview4Caption: Focus on your worldbuilding and let Kanka handle the rest.
comparison.ctaLink: Join 425,000 worldbuilders who didn't want to pay for complexity they'd never use.

comparisonObsidian.title: Kanka vs Obsidian for Worldbuilding & TTRPGs
comparisonObsidian.lead: Obsidian is an awesome, independent Markdown vault for personal notes. Kanka is a purpose-built, web-native worldbuilding and campaign platform, ready out of the box with maps, calendars, timelines, and player permissions, without spending weekends configuring plugins.
comparisonObsidian.tableTitle: At a glance: Kanka vs Obsidian

table.setupKanka: Ready out of the box in minutes; zero plugin upkeep
table.setupComp: Requires finding, configuring, and updating community plugins
table.sharingKanka: Built-in multi-user roles, permissions, and player preview
table.sharingComp: Single-player by default; sharing requires Publish or workarounds
table.visualsKanka: Native, deeply integrated across all entries
table.accessKanka: Web-native across any device; full campaign export anytime
table.accessComp: Offline-first local Markdown files on your device
table.pricingKanka: Free forever with unlimited campaigns & cloud sync
table.pricingComp: Free app; official Sync and Publish are paid add-ons
table.independenceKanka: Independent, no VC, subscriber-funded since 2017; source-available

comparisonObsidian.setupBody1: Obsidian can do almost anything if you install and maintain the right community plugins: dataview, calendars, leaflet maps, fantasy statblocks, and CSS snippets. That flexibility is great if you love tinkering with your setup, though it can quickly turn into a kitchen-sink project where you spend more time configuring tools than building your world.
comparisonObsidian.setupBody2: Kanka gives you 20+ structured worldbuilding categories, {'@'}mentions, relations, calendars, timelines, and quests already wired together from day one. Create a campaign and start building in minutes (be it on desktop, tablet, or phone) with zero plugins to maintain.
comparisonObsidian.preview1Alt: Kanka {'@'}mentions linking characters, locations, and lore automatically
comparisonObsidian.preview1Caption: Link characters, locations, and quests with {'@'}mentions with absolutely no plugin configuration required.
comparisonObsidian.sharingTitle: Sharing With Your Table & Keeping Secrets
comparisonObsidian.sharingBody1: Obsidian is designed primarily as a local, single-player workspace. Sharing parts of your world with players while hiding GM spoilers usually means setting up Obsidian Publish, maintaining separate vaults, or syncing via Git.
comparisonObsidian.sharingBody2: Kanka is collaborative by default. Invite players and co-GMs for free, assign roles, and control visibility per entry, relation, or map pin. Not sure you set it up right? You can preview your campaign as a specific player to be 100% sure your secrets stay hidden.
comparisonObsidian.preview2Alt: Kanka granular permissions and visibility controls for players
comparisonObsidian.preview2Caption: Control exactly what players can see and edit, down to individual entries and map pins.
comparisonObsidian.visualTitle: Maps, Calendars & Timelines Out of the Box
comparisonObsidian.visualBody1: With Kanka, interactive multi-layer maps with permission-aware pins, custom fantasy calendars with moons and seasons, and era-based timelines are core features, not third-party plugins that might break on an update.
comparisonObsidian.preview3Alt: Kanka interactive map with custom pins and layers
comparisonObsidian.preview3Caption: Interactive maps with layers, polygons, and player-safe pins built right in.
comparisonObsidian.preview4Alt: Kanka custom worldbuilding calendar with moons and events
comparisonObsidian.preview4Caption: Custom calendars that automatically link to journals, events, and character ages.
comparisonObsidian.ownershipBody1: Both Obsidian and Kanka share an important value: neither is driven by venture capital. Obsidian keeps your notes as local Markdown files on your drive, which is unbeatable if offline-first local storage is your top priority.
comparisonObsidian.ownershipBody2: Kanka is web-native so your whole group can access it anywhere, and you can export your entire campaign anytime with no lock-in. Kanka's code is also source-available on GitHub and 100% subscriber-funded since 2017.
comparisonObsidian.chooseKanka1: You want a ready-to-use worldbuilding and campaign manager with zero setup
comparisonObsidian.chooseKanka2: You run games for players and need built-in permissions, secrets, and collaboration
comparisonObsidian.chooseKanka3: You want native maps, calendars, timelines, and quests that work together on any device
comparisonObsidian.chooseKanka4: You want free cross-device web access without paying for sync or hosting
comparisonObsidian.chooseObsidian1: You want 100% offline-first local Markdown files on your own hard drive
comparisonObsidian.chooseObsidian2: You enjoy customizing your own workflow with community plugins and templates
comparisonObsidian.chooseObsidian3: You are building purely solo and rarely need live player permissions
comparisonObsidian.testimonialQuote: "I got fed up with Obsidian's lack of focus and World Anvil's clunkiness, so here I am, building my own world—and so far I'm really liking the app."
comparisonObsidian.ctaLink: Start building your world for free

comparisonLegendKeeper.title: Kanka vs LegendKeeper: Worldbuilding Tool Comparison
comparisonLegendKeeper.lead: LegendKeeper is a sleek, visual atlas and whiteboard tool for worlds and maps. Kanka is a free-forever, structured worldbuilding and TTRPG campaign platform with built-in calendars, timelines, quests, 20+ categories, and nearly a decade of independent development.
comparisonLegendKeeper.tableTitle: At a glance: Kanka vs LegendKeeper

table.freePlanComp: Short free trial only; subscription required
table.visualsKanka: Multi-layer maps with pins, polygons, and player visibility
table.visualsComp: Sleek atlas-first UI with integrated whiteboards
table.entitiesComp: Flexible freeform wiki pages and templates
table.campaignToolsKanka: All built in and linked to entries
table.campaignToolsComp: Lightweight timelines; no native custom calendars or quests
table.permissionsKanka: Granular roles, per-entry secrets, and player preview

comparisonLegendKeeper.pricingBody1: One of the biggest differences is how you get started. LegendKeeper is a paid product with a short free trial. If you stop subscribing, you lose edit access to your world.
comparisonLegendKeeper.pricingBody2: Kanka's core platform is free forever: unlimited campaigns, unlimited entries, interactive maps, calendars, timelines, and full player permissions with no credit card required. Most game masters never need to pay, and optional subscriptions (from $4.99/mo) add larger uploads, custom themes, and community plugins.
comparisonLegendKeeper.structureBody1: LegendKeeper shines if you love starting from a visual map or freeform whiteboard canvas and dropping wiki pages onto it.
comparisonLegendKeeper.structureBody2: Kanka takes a structured, relational approach. Characters, locations, organizations, families, items, quests, and custom categories all live in dedicated spaces and connect automatically via {'@'}mentions and relationship webs, making it effortless to find any detail in seconds, even mid-session.
comparisonLegendKeeper.preview1Alt: Kanka campaign dashboard showing structured worldbuilding categories and widgets
comparisonLegendKeeper.preview1Caption: Customizable dashboards keep your characters, locations, calendars, and recaps one click away.
comparisonLegendKeeper.campaignBody1: Running an ongoing campaign takes more than wiki pages. Kanka includes custom fantasy calendars (with moons, seasons, and automatic character age calculation), era-based timelines, quest tracking, inventories, and session journals, all linked to the same world entries.
comparisonLegendKeeper.preview2Alt: Kanka interactive timeline organized by eras and linked events
comparisonLegendKeeper.preview2Caption: Track your world’s history across eras with interactive timelines linked directly to entries.
comparisonLegendKeeper.preview3Alt: Kanka interactive map with layers and permission-controlled pins
comparisonLegendKeeper.preview3Caption: Interactive maps with layers, polygons, and per-pin visibility controls for your players.
comparisonLegendKeeper.stabilityBody1: When you invest years into a world, you want to know the platform won't disappear. Kanka has been independent, profitable, and 100% subscriber-funded since 2017 with no venture capital. Our code is source-available on GitHub, you can export your entire campaign anytime, and Kanka is localized into English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and more. Yes, even in Slovak!
comparisonLegendKeeper.chooseKanka1: You want a generous free-forever plan with unlimited campaigns and entries
comparisonLegendKeeper.chooseKanka2: You want structured categories, custom calendars, timelines, quests, and inventories built in
comparisonLegendKeeper.chooseKanka3: You or your players prefer using the app in French, German, Spanish, or Portuguese
comparisonLegendKeeper.chooseKanka4: You value a source-available platform with full campaign exports and a track record since 2017
comparisonLegendKeeper.chooseLK1: Your workflow centers primarily around a visual map atlas and freeform whiteboards
comparisonLegendKeeper.chooseLK2: You prefer minimal structure over dedicated RPG and worldbuilding categories
comparisonLegendKeeper.chooseLK3: You are comfortable with a paid-only subscription from day one
comparisonLegendKeeper.testimonialQuote: "Got annoyed with how LegendKeeper felt, and other tools seemed overly complicated for no good reason. Kanka has helped me organize my world and thoughts on a much deeper level."

contact.title: We're here for you
contact.lead: Need help, found a bug, or just want to share your love for Kanka? Our team will reply whatever the occasion!
contact.discordBody: If you want to talk to us directly, hop on our {discordServer}.
contact.aboutTeamBody: Kanka is built and maintained by a {teamLink} scattered across Geneva and Mérida. We're passionate about worldbuilding and campaign management, and we love hearing from our users, whether it's bug reports, feature requests, or just sharing how you use Kanka.
contact.responseBody1: We typically respond to all inquiries within {hours}. We value work-life balance and time with our families, so we may not answer immediately, but we will get back to you.
contact.responseBody2: {fastest} Our Discord community is where we're most responsive. If you need urgent help, joining our {discordServer} is your best bet.
contact.responseBody3: {allMethods} Email, Discord, or through any of our social channels. We understand not everyone wants to use Discord or social media, and that's perfectly fine! Send us an email at {email} and we'll help.
contact.downTitle: Is Kanka down or having issues?
contact.downBody: Check {statusLink} to see if we're experiencing downtime. You'll find real-time status updates there.
contact.passwordBody: Use the lost password feature on the {loginLink} to reset it yourself. No need to contact us!

showcase.title: Showcase
showcase.lead: Our showcase highlights a curated selection of campaigns built with Kanka. Each Spotlight features a closer look at how a world was created, what drives it, and the stories that emerge at the table.
showcase.noResults: No featured campaigns yet. Apply to have your shows up here!

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.lead: Our community shape our work, so while we don't have a multi-month roadmap, it is easy to stay up to date with what has been requested and what is currently being worked on.
roadmap.roadmapBody: The roadmap lists all ideas submitted by the community and what we're currently working on, while allowing members to upvote ideas they want to see added to Kanka.
roadmap.devLogsBody: We publish developer logs every few weeks with updates on our progress and upcoming features, as well as tea from behind the scenes.

hallOfFame.title: Hall of fame
hallOfFame.lead: Honestly, it's still a little crazy to us that a weekend hobby project turned into a full-time job for our small team. None of that would have happened without these incredible people. Their support means we can deliver frequent updates, skip the morning standups, work on things we're genuinely passionate about, and keep spreading our love of worldbuilding, one campaign at a time.
hallOfFame.elementalBody: These fantastic people let us know we're working on something truly magical.
hallOfFame.wyvernBody: These are people who run multiple campaigns across multiple worlds, sometimes with huge groups of players. The serious worldbuilders who couldn't achieve their goals without Kanka.
hallOfFame.owlbearBody: The backbone of Kanka's community. Worldbuilding is more than a passing hobby for these people, they wake up with plot hooks ready to add to their worlds. Their projects have long outgrown simple note-taking, and they're building something beautiful.
hallOfFame.goblinBody: Discontinued in early 2020, our loyal Goblins are still supporting us to this day!

partners.title: Partners
partners.lead: We've partnered up with a few amazing tools and communities that share our goals and values.
partners.gramelBody: Gramel Books is small Polish RPG publisher, responsible for Polish editions of Savage Worlds, Dungeon World, Monsterhearts, Beyond the Wall and Other Adventures or Eclipse Phase. They've also published a few English-language supplements for Savage Worlds, most notably Beasts and Barbarians and Tropicana, as well as a simplistic game system called Adventurers. Publishing and playing tabletop RPGs is their passion and favourite past-time for more than 20 years, and they are proud and happy to be part of Kanka project!

security.title: Security
security.lead: Our small team is commited to providing top notch data protection standards to ensure that your data is safe with us.
security.dataCenterBody: Kanka is hosted on multiple servers to ensure redundancy, and we have disaster recovery procedures in place should something bad happen. Our servers are hosted by Hetzner.
security.euBody: Our servers and all of your data is hosted on servers inside the European Union. This allows us to meet specific regulatory and compliance requirements that ensure your data is safe with us. Our data center providers Hetzner and Amazon Cloud Europe have a history of quality and expertise in the handling of digital data.
security.commsBody: All user data is transported securely and privately, as it is encrypted in transit via SSL. Encrypting data in transit protects it from unauthorised snooping, modification, as well as man-in-the-middle attacks.
security.creditBody: We don't store your credit card information. We use Stripe to process credit cards, with all communication between you, our servers, and Stripe being encrypted. The only credit card information provided by Stripe that we store is your card's expiration date and brand, so that we can notify you when your card expires.
security.backupsBody: Our database is backed up twice a day to ensure your data stays safe and highly available. Our database backups are regularly tested to ensure that we can quickly restore data if needed.
security.logsBody: We automatically collect detailed logs to ensure that we can quickly and effectively resolve bugs and issues with users. These detailed logs are frequently purged, and are also automatically purged when when you delete your account.
security.breachBody: Should Kanka be the target of a data breach involving personal data, we will promptly report it to the local authorities as well as to the users involved.

pressKit.title: Press kit
pressKit.lead: Thanks for your interest in Kanka! Please use the following resources when talking about us.
pressKit.shortDescriptionBody1: Kanka is a worldbuilding and tabletop RPG campaign management tool perfect for worldbuilders and game masters alike. It helps you create and organise your campaigns and worlds with a whole range of features such as calendars, interactive maps, timelines, organisations, families, and as many characters as you can come up with!
pressKit.shortDescriptionBody2: Community is in their DNA, and you can vote on community ideas to determine the direction that Kanka takes, as well as their Community Marketplace, where creators can showcase their creativity and make their content useable by others.

ttrpgTools.title: Everything a game master needs, in one place.
ttrpgTools.lead: Kanka is the all-in-one toolkit for tabletop RPG game masters: characters, maps, quests, timelines, and lore, all linked with {'@'}mentions and ready the moment you need them. Works for D&D, any TTRPG, or your own homebrew. Free to start, no credit card. Trusted by 425,000+ DMs.

campaignManager.title: Run your D&D campaign without the chaos.
campaignManager.lead: Kanka is the campaign manager for D&D and tabletop RPG game masters. Track every NPC, quest, and plot thread, link them with {'@'}mentions, and pull up anything mid session, from session one to session fifty. Less prep, more play. Free to start, no credit card. Trusted by 425,000+ GMs.

useCasesIndex.title: Find Your Way to Use Kanka
useCasesIndex.lead: Everyone comes to Kanka with a different story. Some are running campaigns with a dozen moving pieces. Others are building worlds that have lived in their heads for years. Whether you're a game master juggling plots and NPCs, a writer mapping out lore, or a player trying to keep track of your character's history, Kanka shapes itself around how you think. Find your people below.
